digest.component_or_area: CLI guide system & commit-trailer format discovery
propositions: Repo-less CLI clients encounter dead links when internal cross-references in packaged guides use consumer-relative paths (review-policy.md, ../CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/commit-ticket-trailer.md) instead of hosted URLs or CLI references
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT in verify_commit.py) has no CLI-discoverable first-class home; it is only documented in rebar verify-commit-ticket --help with no pointer from rebar explain
Packaged guides must repoint all dangling references to resolve for offline clients: sibling guides as rebar explain <topic>, repo-only docs as https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/… URLs
A regression-proofing guard test must ensure no packaged guide link target is consumer-relative; only https://, http://, #anchor, or mailto: are allowed
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring hardcodes the guide list (plan, review) and must add commit-trailer so clients discover it; AUTHOR_GUIDES registry already loads dynamically
